name: What if I can’t afford a lawyer?

mainEntity.name: What if I can’t afford a lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because contingency fees eliminate upfront costs, financial circumstances would not prevent you from hiring us. Case-related expenses are also advanced by the firm, requiring no cost to you until after a successful resolution of your case.
